instructions: Brown ground turkey in half the olive oil; season and set aside.
Sauté cubed sweet potato in remaining oil until tender, about 10 minutes.
Add garlic and spinach; cook until spinach wilts.
Return turkey and toss everything together.
Serve with Gatorade Thirst Quencher (355 g).
